## Summary

**Root cause:** `src/app/runtime.py` used `from .config import POLICY_MODE`, which binds the value into the module namespace at import time. Any later change to `app.config.POLICY_MODE` (the single source of truth) was invisible to `policy_mode()` — it returned a stale snapshot.

**Changes:**
1. `src/app/runtime.py` — Changed the import to `from . import config` and made `policy_mode()` return `config.POLICY_MODE`, so it resolves the live value at call time.
2. `tests/test_policy_runtime.py` — Added `test_policy_mode_reads_live_config_value`, which mutates `config.POLICY_MODE` (via `monkeypatch.setattr`) and asserts `policy_mode()` reflects the new value.

**Verification:** The full repository test suite passes — **69 passed**.
